title: Verified deployments hand publication to the tag-only OIDC workflow
description: Offline: the real batch-gate loop and merge-writer git push use a temporary bare origin. Verification alone and failed deployments publish nothing; successful deployment pushes exactly one version tag, retained across restarts. Check the workflow's tag-only trigger, OIDC and packages permissions, provenance invocation and absence of npm token secrets. Exercise the shared publisher's server and trial image pushes with command stand-ins.

steps.name: Verify release workflow and post-deploy tag handoff without network
